sources.title: A Case Study – Crosstalk role in delaying full-chip closure
sources.what_it_covers: A multi-million gate SoC where a block-level hold violation appeared only after full-chip integration due to crosstalk delta differences between block-level and full-chip extraction.
sources.why_relevant: Detailed engineering postmortem of a design-closure failure and the debugging/fix process, directly matching the requested congestion/timing-closure war-story theme.
sources.verification_hint: "A Case Study – Crosstalk role in delaying full-chip closure" eInfochips

sources.title: The tapeout we did not finish
sources.what_it_covers: A multi-model AI chip physical-design journey that reached placement, power-grid, routing, and clock-tree stages but was stopped before tapeout due to floorplan and geometry constraints.
sources.why_relevant: First-person postmortem of a physical-design flow that failed to close, covering congestion, floorplanning, power grid, and the decision to postpone tapeout.
sources.verification_hint: "The tapeout we did not finish" wiowiz

sources.title: Debugging post-silicon fails in the IBM POWER8 bring-up lab
sources.venue_or_publication: IBM Journal of Research and Development
sources.what_it_covers: Techniques and mechanisms for debugging post-silicon failures in the POWER8 processor, including several functional bugs and the root-cause analysis process.
sources.why_relevant: Journal paper describing real silicon bring-up failures and recovery, covering the post-silicon validation phase of a complex ASIC.
sources.verification_hint: "Debugging post-silicon fails in the IBM POWER8 bring-up lab"

sources.title: Itanium processor clock design
sources.venue_or_publication: Proceedings of the 2000 international symposium on Physical design (ISPD)
sources.what_it_covers: Clock routing, distributed de-skew buffers, and clock characterization data from initial silicon for the Itanium processor.
sources.why_relevant: Conference paper detailing clock-network design and silicon bring-up challenges for a high-performance microprocessor, including real implementation issues.
